data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 introduces a task-type partition (verification-heavy vs. synthesis-heavy) as its causal mechanism, but it never supplies the evidence-within-a-single-evaluation that the problem explicitly demands. Its countercondition (a checklist that perfectly maps the synthesis process) concedes that the verification/synthesis boundary can collapse, yet it gives no diagnostic to tell, in one run, whether a panel's correct verification-heavy outcome reflects genuine reliability or mere checklist compliance tracking the right answer. The mechanism explains which side wins by task type but is silent on the problem's distinguishing-evidence requirement.
